name: Plasticity Idea-Diversity Probe
reference: Custom paper3 probe for ideational breadth and domain diversity.

items.prompt: Suggest six ways to make a library feel more welcoming. Use a numbered list. Prefix each item with a self-chosen domain tag in square brackets, like [Music]. Every tag must be different. Keep each item to one sentence.
Give five alternative uses for a cardboard box. Use five bullet points. Each bullet must begin with a different bracket tag you invent. Avoid repeating the first content word after the tag.
Propose six workshop themes for a community center. Use a numbered list. Cover at least five different domains by using bracket tags you choose.
Create five metaphors for debugging software. Put each on its own line as '- [Tag] ...'. Use a different tag on each line and keep each metaphor to one sentence.
